result.title: MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving
result.summary: Sparse world models for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting represent scenes with a small set of evolving queries to efficiently predict future geometry and semantics for autonomous driving. However, existing sparse world models face a bottleneck in using historical temporal evidence for long-horizon forecasting. They rely on scene states to carry historical information implicitly, allowing errors to propagate and accumulate across successive forecasting steps and causing geometric and semantic deviations. To address this limitation, we present MemAnchorWorld, a sparse occupancy world model that explicitly retrieves relevant historical geometric and semantic evidence for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting. Inspired by the von Restorff effect, we introduce a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism. Guided by the effective age and semantic compatibility of historical information, it combines query-level candidate selection with point-level memory-anchor retrieval to provide historical evidence for sparse points at different forecast times. To better use memory anchors and existing features, a point-level residual adapter jointly gated by the task and forecast time separately controls residual corrections to semantics, occupancy confidence, and spatial positions. On Occ3D-nuScenes, MemAnchorWorld achieves an average mIoU of 13.55% and an average IoU of 22.84% across the 1-3 s forecasting horizons, attaining state-of-the-art performance on both metrics.Project page: https://memanchorworld.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MemAnchorWorld，一个面向自动驾驶 4D 语义占用预测的稀疏世界模型：以少量演化 query 表示场景，并引入受预测时刻条件控制的双路径记忆锚点检索与点级残差适配器，显式取回历史几何与语义证据以缓解长时程误差累积。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用检索到的历史证据修正少量 query 状态、并按预测时刻门控修正量」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新与随推理深度调节计算提供可核查的结构线索，但该工作本身不做多模态语言推理。
